prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

Changes (with their configs):

   config: {"home_intro": {"layout": "card", "headline": "Mastering Your Desktop Companion", "body": "Learn how to summon, minimize, and chat with your companion directly on your desktop."}}

   config: {"waiting": {"show_time_estimate": true, "tip_delay_seconds": 15, "headline": "Preparing Your Pet's Desktop Space", "body": "Your companion is getting ready to move onto your desktop environment."}}
3: [choose_path, redesign] Story Welcome Exploration Stage Layout: Rebuilds the story intro screen into a full-bleed visual layout setting up the companion journey.
   config: {"story": {"layout": "full_bleed", "headline": "Begin Your Virtual Companion Journey", "body": "Select how you would like to explore your new companion experience."}}

   config: {"sign_in": {"layout": "card", "headline": "Secure Your Companion Account", "body": "Sign in to save your pet's memory, personality, and progress across sessions."}}

   config: {"new_shortcut_guide": {"headline": "Essential Companion Hotkeys", "body": "Quick key combinations to hide, summon, or talk to your pet anytime.", "layout": "checklist"}, "_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro", "new_shortcut_guide"]}
6: [adoption, new_flow] Custom Photo Verification and Preview Flow: Introduces step counter and multi-step progress indicators during custom photo upload for companion creation.
   config: {"upload_photos": {"show_progress": true, "show_step_counter": true, "headline": "Check Photo Quality for Best Pet Generation", "body": "Ensure high resolution and clear lighting for accurate desktop pet rendering."}}
7: [choose_path, hint] Choose Path Quick Start Selection Hint: Adds explicit path duration hints and guidance on quick vs custom setup.
   config: {"choose_path": {"hint": "Choose quick setup for instant companion or custom path for unique traits.", "show_time_estimate": true}}
8: [finish, incentive] Finish Step Companion Care Welcome Perks: Displays a starter care kit unlock badge on the home intro screen upon completing setup.
   config: {"home_intro": {"components": [{"type": "badge", "text": "Starter Care Kit Unlocked", "style": "highlight"}]}}
9: [sign_in, copy] Sign In Cloud Save Guarantee Copy: Clarifies in the body copy that signing in prevents pet loss and protects pet save files.
   config: {"sign_in": {"body": "Signing in ensures your pet data, unlocks, and settings are backed up permanently to the cloud."}}

verdicts.reason: Redesigns the home intro into a card layout without breaking any onboarding rules.
Redesigns pick_friend while maintaining its job of letting the user choose a pet companion.
Adds a wait time estimate and hints during pet generation, which is permitted for real waiting periods.
Redesigns the story screen visual layout while retaining its introductory role.
Updates the sign-in layout and messaging without removing or skipping any steps.
Adds a new shortcut guide screen after home_intro, which is explicitly allowed by rule 4.
Adds step counter and progress indicators to photo upload without changing functionality or rules.
Adds path selection guidance while preserving the choice between adopting and creating a custom pet.
Displays a starter care kit perk badge, violating the rule against mentioning gifts or free extras in onboarding copy.
Updates sign-in copy regarding cloud backups without violating any constraints.
